name: wopr-marketplace
description: WOPR: a right-sized agent harness for Claude Code, shipped as one plugin per pack.

plugins.name: wopr-core
plugins.description: Foundation tools: mental models, debugging, todo management, planning

plugins.name: wopr-angular
plugins.description: Angular development: component patterns, testing, code review

plugins.name: wopr-auditors
plugins.description: Skill, command, and subagent quality auditors

plugins.name: wopr-crew
plugins.description: Universal four-role agent crew (scout, coder, tester, auditor): one REQ per run, API-contract-first (OpenAPI or GraphQL), spec-files-as-authority, coverage-gated. For any disciplined dev project (net-new, ongoing iteration, blocker fix, or frontend handoff).

plugins.name: wopr-meta
plugins.description: Tools for creating new commands, skills, agents, and hooks, plus capturing hard-won knowledge as reusable skills

plugins.name: wopr-python
plugins.description: Python development: FastAPI, AI integrations (Bedrock, Vertex, Pinecone), testing, packaging
